strings.name: Amin H. Nasser
strings.summary: Nasser studied petroleum engineering at King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals and joined Saudi Aramco in 1982, working in production, reservoirs and upstream management. He became President and CEO in 2015, overseeing its major listing and recovery after attacks on facilities. He promotes refining and chemicals investment and continued oil and gas investment, positions debated in relation to energy security and climate transition.
